blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Cebu and its tourism destinations will take center stage as the province hosts the Miss Asia Pacific International 2026 coronation night on October 10. Gabrielle Galapia of Pampanga, the Philippines’ representative to the international pageant, was the first to arrive in Cebu on Friday, September 17. In an interview, Galapia said she is looking forward to tasting Cebu’s famous lechon during her stay. She is also scheduled to visit downtown Cebu City this weekend.
